skills.description: This skill should be used when the user wants to transform a company that still runs on paper ledgers or scattered Excel files into AI-enabled operations, especially when business has outpaced digitalization. It applies the FDE 'from paper ledger to AI operations' methodology: diagnose on-site, build the data foundation (CRM plus data warehouse) before AI, layer AI plus BI ops analysis, AI coaching and resume screening for efficiency, and stand up the client's own AI team. Also use it in pre-sales or client communication to send the on-site diagnosis checklist and scope the engagement. Trigger on requests such as '我们还在用手写台账怎么做AI', '从Excel台账到经营分析怎么做', '帮客户设计销售线AI转型方案', '按 FDE 方法论做数智化诊断', or any paper-ledger / CRM / data-warehouse / AI-ops transformation. Based on real case 18 from the FDE industry-case collection.
skills.description_zh: 跨境经销「从发货到动销」数据断层打通 · FDE 落地法。当用户面临跨境/经销模式下总部只看得见发货(Sell In)、两国动销(Sell Through)是黑箱的问题，需要用 AI 从经销商的 PDF/图片/Excel/手写单据中抽取并校验数据，对齐口径、标记异常、并产出「每个数字都点得开、溯得到源」的可溯源看板时使用。典型触发词：'打通跨境经销的数据断层'、'从发货到动销'、'Sell In 和 Sell Through 对不上'、'经销商数据看不清动销'、'总部只看得见发货看不见动销'、'用 AI 从 PDF/图片/Excel 抽取经销商数据'、'跨境快消数据连通'、'market spend 异常检测'、'可溯源看板'、'经销商填报口径不一。 — English: Use when the HQ sees shipments but not overseas sell-through, or when dealer data comes as unstructured PDF/Excel/photos and calibers across markets don't match. AI extracts & validates dealer data, aligns caliber, flags anomalies, and produces a traceable dashboard where every number is click-to-source. English triggers: 'cross-border distributor data gap', 'Sell In vs Sell Through mismatch', 'distributor sell-through is a black box', 'traceable dashboard for dealer data', 'extract dealer data from PDF/Excel/photos', 'connect overseas sales data', 'unify distributor reporting caliber', 'market spend anomaly detection'. Channel-agnostic & industry-agnostic: ships a client-fillable Excel checklist, a submission schema, and a zero-dependency Python connector (caliber validation + anomaly detection + click-to-trace HTML dashboard).
skills.name: 从发货到动销：用AI打通跨境快消的海外数据断层
